name: Meeting Notes
author: kvango
tagline: Record any call. Clean notes land in your notebook.
description: Records your microphone and the far side of a call as two streams, transcribes locally with Whisper, and writes structured notes — TL;DR, decisions, action items, open questions — plus the full transcript. Nothing leaves your Mac.

notes: Asks for your password once, to install the BlackHole audio driver.
Leave the email blank when it asks — LocalBook files your notes.
When it explains how to build an audio device in Audio MIDI Setup, just click Done. LocalBook builds it for you afterwards.
It also installs llama.cpp and downloads a model for it (several GB). LocalBook can't skip that step, and neither is used once you press Connect.

routing.why: 1:1s with different people belong in different notebooks, and the notes name their participants — so each recording can be placed on its own rather than all of them landing in one pile.

verify.label: the BlackHole audio driver
verify.fix: Without this it can record your microphone but not the other side of a call. Install it with: brew install blackhole-2ch — then restart your Mac.

verify.name: Meeting Output
verify.label: the Meeting Output device
verify.fix: Open Audio MIDI Setup, click + → Create Multi-Output Device, tick your speakers AND BlackHole 2ch, and rename it to 'Meeting Output'.

extras.name: Menu bar control
extras.tagline: Start and stop recording from the macOS menu bar.
extras.description: Adds a microphone icon to the menu bar that turns red while recording. Uses SwiftBar, a small open-source menu bar host.
notes: SwiftBar is an app, not a system driver — installing it needs no password.
The '.10s' in the filename tells SwiftBar to refresh every 10 seconds, which is how the icon notices a recording started from anywhere else.

preflight.label: Finish setup
preflight.summary: Builds the audio device the recorder needs — the one its installer asks you to make by hand. No password required.
